name: MV Electrosystems Ltd

Rs 921.64 Cr executable order book as of Jun 2026 - ~18.6x FY26 revenue

The order book gives real forward visibility IF the company can execute and convert it, but the current numbers alone would not support investment - this is entirely a bet on execution converting the order book into revenue/profit over the next 1-2 years.
